messages:
emma: Opening a PR to migrate the legacy dashboard + tracing samples that use trace_id_v1 to the new trace_key schema and cost attribution shape. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4121 — looking for owners/QA on snippets and a link-sweep.

jordan: thanks emma — can you add a short migration note for customers? maybe a YAML example showing `trace_key: session_id` mapping and `cost_metric: tokens`.

emma: yup adding a migration page under /docs/console/observability/migrations.md. snippet changes: swap `trace_id` -> `trace_key` and flatten `cost_breakdown` into per-route/per-token fields.

riley: ping me for sample code checks (python & node). i'll run the SDK snippets in the sandbox.

devex-bot: build passed for docs site — preview: https://deploy-preview-4121--docs.redwood-inference.com

prashant: quick FYI — samples/dashboards/kv-cost.json still has `latency_ms` as a string. that breaks the dashboard embed renderer. need numeric.

emma: good catch. i'll fix that in the PR.

sofia: for the trace hook snippet, please include Go and Rust examples — we have more customers using those now.

emma: adding a tiny Rust example. snippet: 
```
// attach trace_key to request
req.Header.Set("X-Trace-Key", sessionID)
```

riley: node snippet lgtm but my local tests failed; SDK now expects `traceContext` arg. pushed a small change to the PR branch to reflect that.

emma: thanks. @jordan can you review the migration guide copy? also need someone to run a link sweep to catch /console vs /observability path differences.

jordan: will do a copy pass today. tagging @docops for link sweep.

docops: i can run linkcheck tomorrow morning. any other external links to update? marketplace or integration pages?

sofia: marketplace how-to can wait; not required for this PR.

prashant: QA checklist suggestion: 1) render dashboard JSON in preview, 2) run trace hook examples in sandbox (Go/Rust/JS/Python), 3) verify cost breakdown shows per-route and per-token split, 4) run linkcheck and confirm no redirects.

emma: adding that checklist to the PR description and the docs migration page. assigning reviewers: @jordan, @riley, @sofia. ETA EOD for first pass.

riley: will test python/node snippets and report results here.

jordan: copy edits pushed. small wording tweaks on the migration note.

riley: node tests passing. python snippet needs `pip install redwood-sdk>=2.3` — added that to the snippet header.

emma: updated PR to convert `latency_ms` to numeric and added Go/Rust/JS/Python snippets. ready for final review.

sofia: approved from snippet POV. small nit: migration banner — use :warning: (not :rotating_light:) so it's consistent with other pages.

emma: switched to :warning:. merging after docops linkcheck completes.

docops: linkcheck complete — two internal redirects fixed (console->observability). preview looks good. :thumbsup:

emma: merged — thanks everyone. i'll file a follow-up to port the marketplace example next week.

riley: nice work! :tada:

prashant: heads-up — let's monitor console error rate after rollout in case the embed parser regresses.

emma: agreed, adding a temporary alert (1h) on dashboard parser errors; will remove after 48h if stable.
